paragraphs: Paymentus provides a billing, payment, and interaction platform for service providers across industries. Payment methods on the platform include credit card, debit card, ACH/eCheck, cash at retail locations, and digital wallets. Bill delivery options include paper suppression, eBilling via email, text, and mobile.

The billing and payments line names Utilities, Insurance, Government, Telecom, Higher Ed, Healthcare, and Property Management among the sectors it serves. A banking and fintech line covers bill pay, loan payments, P2P, and A2A for Banks, Credit Unions, and Consumer Finance lenders. Reporting and reconciliation run through an admin solution called Agent Dashboard, with visibility for transactions by payment method and channel.

Paymentus went public on the New York Stock Exchange in 2021. The company describes an Instant Payment Network of billers, financial institutions, and brand partners including PayPal, Walmart, CVS and Walgreens. Case studies on their industry insights pages include one about Sarasota County.

quote.text: Paymentus was founded as the answer to clunky, outdated billing and payment processes that made paying bills too complicated.
